detections.insight: Our analysis reveals that 7 out of 9 SKUs (SKU-BISCUITS, SKU-EARPHONES, SKU-KEYBOARD, SKU-MOISTURIZER, SKU-OIL, SKU-RICE, and SKU-SUNSCREEN) have stock counts less than their reorder points across all locations, indicating a high risk of stockouts and potential revenue loss. This trend suggests a need for improved inventory management and supply chain optimization. Furthermore, the absence of SKU-SHIRT and SKU-SNEAKERS from this list may indicate that these items are not as critical or in high demand.
detections.recommendation: To mitigate the risk of stockouts, we recommend implementing a 'Just-in-Time' (JIT) inventory replenishment strategy for the 7 high-risk SKUs, which involves automating the replenishment process based on real-time sales data and inventory levels. Additionally, we suggest conducting a thorough review of the reorder points for these SKUs to ensure they are accurately set and aligned with business needs, and adjusting them as necessary to prevent stockouts and minimize waste.
